name: tether
description: Per-user session daemon that owns tmux session lifecycle for Aico and A-Term.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/tether.mjs --banner:js="// Tether daemon and CLI bundle. Built by npm run build; do not edit."
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
